chapter: The Second Herd and its sidemen
title: Finding Stan Getz
summary: Getz was recommended as an unknown young player; Herman is unsure which band he came from.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Playing with Miles Davis: joining, sessions and the band

blocks.x: Good. Well, then -- did you get Getz very easily? Where did you find him?
I don't know, I'm not sure if he came to us directly from Stan's band or from --
Or from somebody like Jack Teagarden's big band.
Who helped you locate him? Did you think about him or --
No, he was just recommended to me.
Oh, he was recommended to you.
I see. Because at that time they were all kind of in that same mode.
Yeah, that's it, and they were all unknown guys. You only knew them, like, -- the same reputations I hear about young players every day in the same way.
'And there's a guy from -- used to be around New York, or he was in Philadelphia. He's out here now, and his name is Stan Getz.'
